# Trump White House Archives

> Official archived documentation of the Trump administration (2017-2021) covering policy initiatives, personnel, and key accomplishments across domestic and foreign affairs.

This archive preserves the Trump administration's official website content, including policy positions on economy, national security, immigration, and foreign relations, along with biographical information on President Trump, Vice President Pence, and First Lady Melania Trump. The site serves as a historical record of the 45th presidency's major initiatives and executive actions.

## Key Topics

- Trump Administration
- Economic Policy
- National Security
- Immigration & Border Security
- Executive Orders
- Foreign Policy
- Workforce Development
- American Leadership
- COVID-19 Response
- Peace to Prosperity Plan
- Tax Cuts and Jobs Act
- Space Force
- Energy Independence
- Presidential Leadership
- Administration Achievements

## Core Administration

- [The White House](https://trumpwhitehouse.archives.gov): Homepage for Trump White House archives featuring administration overview.
- [Donald J. Trump](https://trumpwhitehouse.archives.gov/people/donald-j-trump): 45th President Trump biography and first-term accomplishments.
- [Michael R. Pence](https://trumpwhitehouse.archives.gov/people/mike-pence): Vice President Mike Pence biography and political career.
- [Melania Trump](https://trumpwhitehouse.archives.gov/people/melania-trump): First Lady Melania Trump biography and BE BEST initiative.
- [Karen Pence](https://trumpwhitehouse.archives.gov/people/karen-pence): Second Lady Karen Pence biography and charitable work.
- [Farewell Address](https://trumpwhitehouse.archives.gov/farewell-address): President Trump's farewell address on national unity and legacy.

## Domestic Policy & Economic Issues

- [Economy & Jobs](https://trumpwhitehouse.archives.gov/issues/economy-jobs): Trump administration economic policy, employment records, and wage growth.
- [Budget & Spending](https://trumpwhitehouse.archives.gov/issues/budget-spending): Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Opportunity Zones, and fiscal policy initiatives.
- [Immigration](https://trumpwhitehouse.archives.gov/issues/immigration): Border security, immigration enforcement, and southern border policy.
- [Energy & Environment](https://trumpwhitehouse.archives.gov/issues/energy-environment): Energy independence, oil/gas production, and climate policy positions.
- [Pledge to America's Workers](https://trumpwhitehouse.archives.gov/pledge-to-americas-workers): Workforce development, job training, and skills-based hiring program.

## National Security & Foreign Policy

- [National Security & Defense](https://trumpwhitehouse.archives.gov/issues/national-security-defense): Military rebuilding, defense spending, Space Force, and counter-terrorism.
- [Foreign Policy](https://trumpwhitehouse.archives.gov/issues/foreign-policy): NATO, Iran sanctions, North Korea diplomacy, and international relations.
- [Peace to Prosperity](https://trumpwhitehouse.archives.gov/peacetoprosperity): Middle East peace plan proposal for Israel-Palestinian resolution.

## Special Initiatives & Programs

- [Artificial Intelligence for the American People](https://trumpwhitehouse.archives.gov/ai): AI policy, innovation strategy, and workforce development initiative.
- [BE BEST](https://trumpwhitehouse.archives.gov/bebest): First Lady Melania Trump's initiative on child well-being and safety.
- [Women's Global Development and Prosperity Initiative](https://trumpwhitehouse.archives.gov/wgdp): Women empowerment and economic development led by Ivanka Trump.

## Government Offices & Advisory Councils

- [Council of Economic Advisers](https://trumpwhitehouse.archives.gov/cea): Economic policy advisory council and domestic economic strategy.
- [Council on Environmental Quality](https://trumpwhitehouse.archives.gov/ceq): Environmental policy, NEPA regulations, and federal permitting.
